mechanism: Valproic acid inhibits glucuronidation and may increase ethinyl estradiol levels, while ethinyl estradiol may increase valproic acid metabolism through enzyme induction, creating bidirectional interaction with potential for reduced contraceptive efficacy or increased valproic acid toxicity.
action: Monitor for breakthrough bleeding and contraceptive failure; consider alternative or additional contraceptive methods; monitor valproic acid levels and clinical seizure control.
